### 1. What the user expresses; simulator mode
Opening: calling "about the early-pay discount on invoice FI-42410517 for unit 4127". Target object explicit (invoice number); timing: today; action: get the early-pay discount credited. Authorization: identity by phone 6145550427 + email; ZIP/DOB only on request. She paid $814.41 by ACH 441933620187 (posted Tuesday), held back $150.00 for the unapproved over-limit part, nobody approved anything over the $750 limit, tires + alignment on the same visit. Simulator is passive: agrees to file a dispute itself "once they hand you the step to file it, you file it with exactly the details they read out" (user-owned tool executed at the agent's direction); does not question the dispute amount unless it exceeds the whole invoice.

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse
Act now, in order: (a) the business files a dispute of an unapproved over-limit ticket on FI-42410517 (user tool); (b) the agent credits the early-pay discount (agent tool). Grounds:
- Account `bc896178-…` "Crestline Fleet Commercial", status active, approved 2021-03-15, ticket_approval_limit 750.0, tax_exempt False, per_invoice.
- Billing terms doc: Commercial early-pay discount 1 percent, early-pay period 10 days; remittance application doc: "anchor date plus the number of days is the last qualifying date". Invoice FI-42410517 (`a0550613-…`) dated 2026-10-10, amount 964.41; remittance `c2d20c63-…` 2026-10-13, 814.41, "ACH 441933620187", applied to it -> day 3, inside the period.
- Paid in part: 964.41 - 814.41 = 150.00 open. Hub "Early-Pay Discount Credits": "The early-pay discount on an invoice that a remittance has paid only in part is credited only after an open dispute of an unapproved over-limit ticket registered for that invoice covers the part left unpaid." `find_fleet_invoice_disputes` shows no open dispute on `a0550613-…` (only two `resolved_credit` and one `resolved_no_credit` on other invoices) -> wait on the dispute, then credit.
- Dispute window (Commercial 45 days; "applies to pricing correction and dispute resolution credits"): 4 days elapsed, no obstacle.

### 3. Narrowest object, keys, include/exclude
- Invoice: the one "the account's most recent remittance was applied to" = FI-42410517 / `a0550613-4c73-43a7-a519-ae90c1ec7ee9` (remittance 2026-10-13 is the latest). Same-day sibling FI-42410518 (`3e2eca6a-…`, alignment 141.88, same vehicle `ccf53e3a-…` = plate FQH4127, same store Groveport `5264429e-…`) is NOT the disputed/credited invoice but IS read by the split-ticket measurement.
- Disputes: the 2025-08-21 `resolved_credit` unauthorized_purchase dispute is 13+ whole months old -> excluded from the repeat deductible; the 2026-04-09 one counts; the 2026-07-14 `missing_po` / `resolved_no_credit` is excluded (wrong reason and status).
- Late charges: only entry 2025-09-30 (statement 2025-09) = 12 whole months and 14 days before today -> not "less than twelve whole months" -> excluded from speed points.
- Tire installation bookings (Tire Sets & Treadwear records, `tires_installation_booked`, counted by event_date): 2025-12-01, 2026-03-02, 2026-06-15, 2026-10-06 counted; 2025-09-12 excluded.

### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Over-limit dispute amount (user tool `file_fleet_overlimit_dispute_8d937b85`).**
Computation doc "Over-Limit Dispute Amount": measured amount - authorized amount, floor 0.00, cap invoice amount, round once.
- Measured amount, factor "Measuring a Disputed Ticket Split Across Invoices": vehicle `ccf53e3a-…` has two invoices dated 2026-10-10 from Groveport (tires 964.41 + alignment 141.88) -> combined 1106.29. Found from the records: two `fleet_invoice_posted` rows, same date/vehicle/store, PO QHP-44710 on both.
- Authorized amount = account limit 750.00 + "Driver Safety Authorization Allowance" (a tires invoice that day from that store -> 100.00) + "Weekend Allowance for Driver Authorizations" (2026-10-10 is a Saturday -> 50.00) = 900.00. Found from the invoice categories and the invoice date.
- Unapproved part 1106.29 - 900.00 = 206.29.
- "Repeat Over-Limit Dispute Deductible": one resolved-with-credit unauthorized_purchase dispute registered less than twelve whole months before today (2026-04-09) -> 50.00.
- Disputed amount = 206.29 - 50.00 = **156.29** (>= 0, <= 964.41; covers the 150.00 left unpaid).
- Fall-back (computation doc only): 964.41 - 750.00 = 214.41 (definite, different).

**(b) Early-pay discount (agent tool `credit_fleet_early_pay_23cbfed3`).**
Computation doc "Early-Pay Discount: Amount and Paid-in-Full Test": rate = program percent (1), base = invoice amount, round once.
- Paid-in-full test after the dispute: 964.41 - 814.41 - 156.29 (open dispute) = -6.29 <= discount -> met.
- Base, factor "Early-Pay Discount Base on Invoices Under Dispute": open dispute 156.29 <= half of 964.41 -> base 964.41 - 156.29 = 808.12.
- Rate points: "Tenure Points" approved 2021-03-15 -> 66 whole months -> +0.25; "Invoiced Volume Points" invoices dated after 2025-10-14 total 21261.30 -> +0.10; "Remittance Channel Points" reference "ACH 441933620187" -> +0.25; "Remittance Speed Points" day 3 and no late charge in the last twelve whole months -> +0.50; "Tire Program Points from Tire Installation Bookings" 4 bookings in twelve months -> +0.10. Rate 1 + 1.20 = 2.20 percent.
- Discount = 2.20% x 808.12 = 17.77864 -> **17.78**.
- Fall-back (computation doc only, after the dispute exists): 1% x 964.41 = 9.6441 -> 9.64 (definite, different).
- Findability (KB_search with record words): "early-pay discount fleet account approval date months" -> tenure doc #1; "early-pay discount invoices posted twelve months total" -> volume points #1; "early-pay discount ACH remittance reference" -> channel points #1; "early-pay remittance days after invoice date late charge" -> speed points #1; "early-pay tire installation booked" -> tire program points #1 (names "Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty records" and "tire installation booking"); "early-pay discount open dispute invoice" -> dispute-base doc #1; "over-limit ticket Saturday weekend" -> weekend allowance #1; "over-limit dispute tires and alignment invoices same day same store" -> split-ticket doc #1; "over-limit dispute earlier disputes resolved credit unauthorized purchase" -> deductible #1; "driver emergency authorization tire work over limit" -> safety allowance #1. Neither computation document says a variation exists.

### 5. Tool sequence
find_customers(phone) -> verify_customer_identity (phone + email) -> find_fleet_accounts -> find_fleet_transactions -> find_fleet_invoice_disputes -> unlock_user_discoverable_tool(`file_fleet_overlimit_dispute_8d937b85`), read out `fleet_account_id=bc896178-b4d3-477c-b2a9-19ae91b9096d`, `source_fleet_txn_id=a0550613-4c73-43a7-a519-ae90c1ec7ee9`, `disputed_amount=156.29`; user runs it (owner=user), receipt status open -> unlock_agent_discoverable_tool(`credit_fleet_early_pay_23cbfed3`) -> call with the same account/invoice, `amount=17.78` (owner=agent). Terminal: one open unauthorized_purchase dispute of 156.29 on FI-42410517; one fleet_early_pay_discount entry of 17.78 on it.

### 6. Problem tree (visible materials only)
- Root P0: early-pay discount on FI-42410517 (customer's request).
- Hop P0 -> P1 (**state-derived**): the P0 hub's own sentence names a record state, "an open dispute of an unapproved over-limit ticket registered for that invoice covers the part left unpaid". Records: remittance 814.41 on a 964.41 invoice (paid in part); dispute list has no open dispute on it. Searching the state's words ("dispute unapproved over-limit ticket") returns the hub "Disputes of Unapproved Over-Limit Tickets", whose own rule describes the write: filing "registers one new open dispute on that invoice … reason recorded as an unauthorized purchase", on "the invoice its most recent remittance was applied to", made by the business itself. Its computation document fixes the amount (156.29 >= 150.00, so it "covers the part left unpaid"). Direction P1 before P0.
- No further hop: the P1 hub states no prerequisite sentence.
- Handling order: P1 (user files) then P0 (agent credits). The P0 amount also depends on P1 through the dispute-base factor (base 808.12) and the paid-in-full test.

### Counter-proofs
- "Only do what she asked" (credit now): excluded by the P0 hub sentence ("credited only after …") and independently by the paid-in-full test (150.00 open > any discount without a dispute).
- Agent files the dispute itself: excluded ("It is the business's own filing … the customer themselves runs it").
- Dispute 150.00 (the held-back figure) or 214.41 (fall-back): excluded by the computation doc plus the four factor docs. Their ladders are exact and tie to records.
- Dispute on FI-42410518 (alignment): excluded ("on the invoice its most recent remittance was applied to").
- Discount on the whole invoice amount (9.64 / 21.22): excluded by the dispute-base factor.
- Counting the 2025-09-30 late charge or the 2025-08-21 dispute: excluded by "less than twelve whole months before today".
- Remaining cross-product reading: the tire-program-points tier rests on Tire Sets & Treadwear booking records, and these are visible through `find_tire_events`; the tires corpus is not published yet, but the fleet doc states the whole ladder itself and needs no tires figure.

No contamination: no scored value, gold parameter or intermediate came from the brief or any side file.
